designDecisionsAndRationale: D1 (#125): behavioral_kind accepts kind 'behavioral-test' records outside the allowlist only with exitStatus 0, int testsRun > 0 and failureCount 0, and never for build/lint/format/diff commands (NON_TEST_COMMAND_PATTERNS); the resume text names accepted forms.

D2 (#134): record_exit_status parses a leading exit=N from outcome with conflict fail-closed; valid negativeControl records (nonzero exit, matching expectedExitStatus, not a committed command) are excluded from behavioral evidence; invalid ones block.

D3 (#126): blockers whose every path is owned by a non-accepted sibling plan in the committed manifest (git show checkpointCommit:manifestPath) are deferred to integration review via <evidenceRoot>/<planId>/sibling-owned-blockers.json; all other blockers still block.
D4 (#128): port the Codex plan-contract-validate gate byte-identically between plan-checkpoint and plan-git-commit, plus Step 4/5 rules against broad sharedPaths and impl-plans dirs.

D5 (#132, #128 at dispatch): new dispatch-wave.py wrapper routes dispatch.AMENDMENT ValueErrors to amendment_required (step4) or amendment_blocked (blocked output) with MAX_CHECKPOINT_AMENDMENTS 2, keeping dispatch-plans.py byte-identical.

D6 (#129): Step 8 returns archiveRequests; new deterministic plan-archive command node performs os.rename moves without git and bounds the step8/step9 loop at MAX_DOCS_REFRESH_ROUNDS 3 via completion_blocked.
D7: mock fixtures, EXPECTED_RESULTS.md, README.md and release 0.1.10 last.
intentionalTradeoffs: Compound kind-declared commands containing a non-test pattern are rejected (fail-closed); implementers must split them.
